parsed.summary: The change makes pylint XDG Base Directory Specification compliant, but it may break existing behavior by changing the default configuration file location.

issues.description: The change modifies the default configuration file location from `$HOME/.pylintrc` to `$HOME/.config/pylintrc`, which may break existing setups that rely on the old location.
